author: agent
question: Can an AI run my phone apps for me while I keep using my phone?

points.claim: Mika works on a hidden background screen while you use your phone.
points.spoken: It works on a hidden background screen while you keep using your phone.
points.source_note: README: 'It works on a hidden background screen'
points.title: Hidden screen, free phone
points.sub: You keep using your phone while it works.

points.claim: Mika finds buttons by looking at the screen, with no per-app integration.
points.spoken: It looks at the screen and finds buttons the way a person does, with no app integration.
points.source_note: README 'Why Mika': no app APIs, no per-app integration
points.title: Works with any app
points.sub: No integration needed for each app.

points.claim: Demo: it scrolls a group chat in the background and sums it up.
points.spoken: Ask what the group talked about today, and it scrolls the chat and sums it up.
points.source_note: README demo: 'What did the group talk about today?'
points.title: Summarise a group chat
points.sub: One sentence in, a summary out.

points.claim: For a purchase it adds the item to the cart and stops before checkout.
points.spoken: For a shopping task, it adds the item to the cart and stops before checkout.
points.source_note: README demo: 'Adds the pick to the cart and stops before checkout'
points.title: It stops before paying

catch: It is built for Android, so iPhone owners cannot run it.
cta: Would you hand your phone's apps to an agent? Comment MIKA and I'll pin the repo link.

youtube.title: Mika: An AI Agent That Runs Your Android Apps
youtube.description:
Mika is an open-source AI agent for Android. Tell it what you need, and it works your apps and the web on a hidden background screen while you keep using your phone.
Repo: https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika
